verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway, so this axis applies, but no evidence states what latency overhead the gateway itself adds. The closest support is Latency-Based Routing, which picks the fastest model from real-time performance data. Real-time latency tracking in analytics and token streaming also help, but none of these quantify the router's own overhead. Missing for 10: any documented or benchmarked gateway overhead figure (e.g., added ms per request), independent or hands-on latency measurements, and documentation of edge or regional deployment aimed at low overhead.
